meta.name: Soulmates
meta.description:
Two ex-schoolmates bump into each other while on a trip to Shillong. Priyanshu, an aspiring music composer who is in Shillong chasing the girl of a rock band accidentally meets his schoolmate Anshul Chauhan who is on a solo bike trip across northeast. Two meet unexpectedly and fall in love, or maybe they don't, but both of them have been giving some really adorable vibes.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 4 Aug 2018 · India · Language: Hindi · 10 min
Studio: Zoom Studios · Network: YouTube

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Shillong
videos.overview: Priyanshu is an aspiring music composer who is in Shillong chasing the lead singer of a rock band when he accidentally meets his school classmate, Anshul, who is on a bike trip across northeast.

videos.title: 3 a.m. Waali Baatein
videos.overview: Anshul decides to accompany Priyanshu to a club where his crush is performing. The two of them then go for a walk and have an extremely personal and heartfelt conversation.

videos.title: Impulsive Planning Disorder
videos.overview: Priyanshu is in a cab which is racing a bit rashly trying to catch the band once again when the cab crashes into Anshul's bike. The two are once again forced to hang out where Anshul narrates her extremely specific road trip plans.

videos.title: Finding Tripti
videos.overview: Anshul decides to modify her bike trip and help Priyanshu find and meet this girl he is obsessed with.

videos.title: A Walk Down Memory Lane
videos.overview: Priyanshu riding pillion on Anshul's bike takes them through some magical and beautiful places in the northeast. This leads them to a dead-end of sorts when they take a boat to the wrong island and are stranded.

videos.title: Gary's Island
videos.overview: Stranded on an isolated island, Priyanshu and Anshul find a saviour in Gary who lives on the island. Over some authentic northeastern food and some very strong drinks, Priyanshu finds out some rather disturbing truths.

videos.title: Fishing Off
videos.overview: A new day dawns on the island where Priyanshu, Anshul and Gary decide to go fishing. What starts off as a pleasant experience soon turns into an epic fight.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Priyanshu and Anshul sort their issues out on a long boat ride off the island. But a whole set of new emotions surface which the two of them have to either face or ignore.

videos.title: Sab Cards Table Pe
videos.overview: There is obviously some really strong attraction brewing between Priyanshu and Anshul. They cannot hide their feelings and decide to list down the pros and cons of being in a relationship with each other.

videos.title: PriyAnshuls as Soulmates?
videos.overview: It's time for Anshul to carry on with her bike trip. But a night they spend in the same hotel room changes things between Priyanshu and her. Will she stay back? Will he join her trip?
